dict.string: Add todo items to hypr-visr with "todo {title}"
Add a new todo to hypr-visr

Type "todo " followed by your todo title to add it to hypr-visr.
Example: todo Buy groceries
The todo will be added to the "Alfred" list in hypr-visr (created automatically if it doesn't exist).
Requirements: hypr-visr must have been opened at least once so that ~/.hypr-visr/tasks.json exists.
